# hmatrix-bridges: pinned third-party libraries. deps/build_deps.sh reads the repository and
# commit of each line from this file, checks out exactly that commit and verifies it (and the
# commit date given here). To move a library to another commit, edit its line and re-run the
# script: the library is rebuilt, and deps/README.md says what to re-check.
#
# Fields, separated by '|':
#   id | library | repository | commit | commit date (committer, UTC offset dropped) | licence | build options
# id names the library for --only and its directories deps/src/<id>, deps/build/<id> and
# <prefix>/<id>. Lines with an id "<parent>:<path>" are git submodules: they are fetched at the
# revision their parent commit records, and the script checks that it is the one listed here.
# Licences were read from each repository's LICENSE/COPYING file at the pinned commit.
#
htool  | Htool-DDM     | https://github.com/htool-ddm/htool            | 0ee4cacabec0045ede8d6602587e8864433c5000 | 2026-10-06 | MIT | header-only: include/htool copied, nothing compiled; used without MPI
h2lib  | H2Lib         | https://github.com/H2Lib/H2Lib                | 920662c7302def7285c5e9a34d919a25f079a640 | 2020-02-13 | LGPL-3.0 | branch "community"; H2Lib make, target libh2.a, options.inc OPT=1 USE_BLAS=1 USE_OPENMP=1 HARITH_RKMATRIX_QUICK_EXIT=1 with system.inc.linux (gcc -Wall -O3 -march=native -funroll-loops -fopenmp); static, no -fPIC

starsh | STARS-H       | https://github.com/ecrc/stars-h               | c115e756553ed683d9f4b63204e68f4b93e133a5 | 2023-11-20 | BSD-3-Clause | CMake Release (-O3 -DNDEBUG), OPENMP=ON, MPI=OFF, STARPU=OFF, GSL=OFF, CUDA=OFF, KBLAS=OFF, BLA_VENDOR=Open (OpenBLAS), EXAMPLES=OFF, TESTING=OFF, DOCS=OFF; static libstarsh.a; SARS-CoV-2-meshes (113 MB) not checked out
